$comment: RouteToAbroad v3 image generation manifest. Every image is regenerable: `npm run images:generate` then `npm run images:process`. Art direction: warm photojournalistic, natural light, slightly desaturated, film grain — consistent across all prompts via STYLE_SUFFIX.
styleSuffix: Warm photojournalistic documentary photography, natural directional light, slightly desaturated warm tones, subtle 35mm film grain, high detail, realistic, no text, no watermarks, no logos, no clichéd handshake or globe imagery

images.name: hero-campus-ink
images.style: Fine ink line-art illustration on paper, monochrome ink linework with a single periwinkle accent, hand-drawn editorial style, no shading gradients, no photography, no text, no watermarks, no logos
images.alt: A university campus drawn as a fine ink line panorama
images.prompt: Wide panoramic architectural elevation drawing of a Chinese university campus skyline, mixing traditional curved tile rooftops with modern campus buildings and a prominent clock-tower, drawn in fine thin black ink lines with light hatching on a pure white background, vintage engraving style, crisp linework, generous white space above and below the skyline

images.name: hero-home
images.alt: Students crossing a sunlit Chinese university campus plaza on a autumn morning
images.prompt: Wide shot of Chinese and international students with backpacks crossing a sunlit university campus plaza in Beijing, ginkgo trees with golden leaves, modern campus buildings and traditional Chinese rooflines in the background, candid unposed moment

images.name: hero-education
images.alt: Medical and engineering students collaborating in a bright modern Chinese university laboratory
images.prompt: International students in a bright modern Chinese university engineering laboratory, one writing formulas on a glass board, others around a workbench with robotics equipment, large windows with soft daylight, candid documentary moment

images.name: hero-tourism
images.alt: A traveller looking out over the Great Wall of China at Mutianyu in golden evening light
images.prompt: Lone traveller with a small daypack standing on a restored tower of the Great Wall of China at Mutianyu, wall snaking over forested ridges into haze, golden late-afternoon light, wide cinematic composition

images.name: hero-trade
images.alt: Container cranes working at the Guangzhou port at dawn
images.prompt: Container terminal at the Port of Guangzhou at dawn, gantry cranes loading a cargo ship, stacked colourful shipping containers, soft orange sunrise light over the Pearl River, industrial documentary style

images.name: university-peking

images.name: university-fudan

images.name: university-zhejiang

images.name: university-sjtu

images.name: city-beijing

images.name: city-shanghai

images.name: blog-trade-corridor
